findings: Stowaway pattern is exactly the kind of write-then-rename crash debris that should never live in VCS. The fix is removing the bad data, not adding new abstractions. No coordination kernel, no new lane, no script — just `git rm --cached`.
.gitignore pattern already enforces the rule for future writes; this slice only untracks legacy entries. No mechanism needs to change.

git rm --cached only (drop from index, leave history)

F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: git rm --cached has the right blast radius for this severity. History retention is acceptable for non-credential filesystem-path leakage. If history scrubbing is required, that's a separate ADR-gated slice.
